k: a positive integer equal to the number of moduli and congruences
m_i: the i-th pairwise coprime integer modulus, greater than 1
a_i: the arbitrary integer prescribed modulo m_i
M_i: the product of all m_j with j different from i
S: the set of positive integer linear combinations used to prove Bézout's identity
c: the least positive element of S
e_i: the integer u_i M_i, congruent to 1 modulo m_i and 0 modulo all other moduli
d: the difference of two simultaneous solutions
